text:
Aisha: Heads up — NimbleCart trial cohort 3 onboarding stalled. Usage flat for the last 7 days and renewal is in 27 days. Flagging risk of downgrade. Key blockers reported: data ingestion failing, SSO not configured, engineering team unsure of immediate ROI. Need a concise micro-save plan + enablement handoff. Any quick wins? :warning:

Jon: looping in @Marta (enablement) and @Sam (AE). Can we get a 30m sync today? Also need the ingestion error logs and last successful run.

Marta: I can take this — available 3–4pm PT. Quick enablement checklist I usually send: 1) SSO quick-start doc, 2) sample dataset + manifest, 3) one-pager ROI with token estimates. I can draft those templates and a 15m troubleshooting script. :white_check_mark:

Sam: NimbleCart's economic owner is Ben (CTO). I'll reach out ASAP to escalate. Do we have per-feature usage so I can show what they're missing?

Zoey: pulled feature usage; summary: ingestion failure is the dominant blocker. Sharing analytics export: https://redwood.internal/usage/nimblecart.csv — 74% of import jobs error due to schema mismatch, ingestion retries exhaust, so customers see empty project.

SupportBot: Ticket #CS-12345 opened for NimbleCart ingestion failures. Status: triaged -> engineering assigned. ETA for first response: 2h.

Marta: Proposed micro-save play (short):

```
- Step 0: Immediate outreach (Sam) within 24h: offer 15m troubleshooting + 30m enablement session.
- Step 1: Support triage to unblock ingestion (attach logs, sample payload).
- Step 2: Marta to send SSO quick guide + sample dataset and manifest.
- Step 3: Jon to run canary import and validate KV/cache settings on a staging replica.
- Step 4: Build quick ROI calc (baseline usage vs projected tokens saved by enabling feature).
- Offer: If unresolved in 72h, provide 1-month credit + 1:1 onboarding engineer.
```

Jon: I'll run a canary import at 11am PT tomorrow and post logs here. Command I'm using: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.local/import -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -F 'file=@sample.csv' -F 'manifest=@manifest.json'` — will include stdout/stderr. :computer:

Marta: I'll prep the SSO doc and sample manifest by EOD and drop them in the account folder. Will also spin up a 15m debug checklist so anyone can run it.

Sam: I'll email Ben and loop in their engineering director. @Aisha can you add an account note with the owners and target SLA for resolution? I'll mention the potential credit offer.

Aisha: Added account note and set a 72h reminder. Owners: Sam (AE), Marta (Enablement), Jon (Success Eng), Support (CS-12345). Follow-ups: Jon to post canary results, Support to update ticket, Marta to share templates. If we don't hit a green status in 72h, escalate to Escalation channel and offer the credit. :eyes: :thumbsup:

Sam: I'll report back after Ben call. Thanks all — this looks actionable and tight.

Zoey: I'll monitor usage metrics and post a delta snapshot after the canary.

SupportBot: Ticket #CS-12345 updated: engineering assigned -> investigation in progress.

Jon: Can confirm canary scheduled; will post results as a follow-up message.

Marta: Templates uploaded: /accounts/nimblecart/onboarding/templates/SSO_quickstart.md and sample_manifest_v2.json

Aisha: Great work. We'll aim to convert this to a documented save-play if successful. Keeping this thread as the single source of truth.
